s: The LM-80 data is used with this additional data to define the L70 rating of the LED. A common misconception when considering fixture life is only accounting for the L70 rating. More often than not, the point of failure is the driver. Driver life is estimated using MTBF or accelerated thermal test data at elevated ambient temperatures which are then extrapolated using Bellcore or Milspec standards. Fixture lifetime must take into account the lifetimes of both the LEDs and the driver.
